title: Uniform norm bound for low degree functions
statement: Let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube with Fourier degree at most $k$, where $k\in\mathbb N$. Its uniform norms satisfy $\|f\|_2\le e^k\|f\|_1$.
hypotheses_covered: Real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
